quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: What do diagonal stripes sloping downward to the left on a barricade or panel mean?
questions.explanation: Diagonal stripes on a barricade guide drivers which way to go. Stripes sloping down and to the left mean turn left. Stripes sloping down and to the right mean turn right.

questions.question: When you turn, you must ____ your speed.
questions.explanation: Slow down when turning. This helps you stay in control of your vehicle, keep your car in its lane, and react to problems.

questions.question: ____ greatly increase how long it takes to stop and how bad crashes are.
questions.explanation: Driving fast greatly increases stopping distance and crash severity. The faster you drive, the harder your car will hit if there is a crash.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will come next.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will appear next.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle, what should you do?

options.text: Stop right away and let it pass.
Move to the right side of the road as far as safely possible and stop.
Drive slowly and let it pass.
Keep driving slowly on the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right side of the road as far as safely possible and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle is using lights and/or a siren, move as far right as possible and stop. Do not stop in an intersection.

questions.question: Before making a right turn, where should your car be positioned?

options.text: Near the center of the road.
Close to the left side of the road.
Close to the right side of the road.
Past the center of the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Close to the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Get as far to the right as possible before turning right. Do not cut across other lanes when turning.

questions.question: If you stop on the road at night, what should you do?

options.text: Turn on emergency flashers and low beam headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on emergency flashers and low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Turn on your emergency flashers and low beam headlights so other drivers can see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.question: Can you drive around or under a lowering or raising gate at a railroad crossing?

options.text: Yes, if a train is not too close.
Yes, if your vehicle fits without hitting the gate.
Yes, if you look both ways carefully.

questions.explanation: When red lights, bells, or gates are active at a railroad crossing, you must stop completely. Never cross the tracks. Do not drive around or under a moving gate.

questions.question: You are entering a busy freeway. How should you merge into traffic?

options.text: Use mirrors and check blind spots.
Use the entrance ramp to match freeway traffic speed.
Let traffic on the freeway go first.

questions.explanation: Use the entrance ramp to reach the same speed as freeway traffic and let traffic already on the freeway pass first. Check your mirrors and blind spots to make sure it is safe to merge.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast on wet roads. Driving slower reduces the risk of hydroplaning.

questions.question: What should you do if your accelerator pedal gets stuck while driving?

options.text: Reach down and try to pull it up.
Shift to neutral and press the brake pedal firmly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake pedal firmly.
questions.explanation: If the accelerator sticks, keep your eyes on the road. Shift into neutral and press the brake pedal firmly. When it is safe, pull off the road and turn off the engine.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns drivers to watch for bicycles crossing.

questions.question: When turning left, who must you yield to?

options.text: Other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You must also always yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: What should you do if a police officer stops you?

options.text: Stop in the middle of the road.
Pull to the right side of the road.
Pull to the left side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: When stopped by police, pull as far to the right as possible. If available, use the right shoulder or a nearby well-lit side street or parking lot away from heavy traffic.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with multiple tracks?

options.text: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before crossing.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go through as soon as the train passes.
Go through when one track is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before crossing.
questions.explanation: Do not move as soon as a train passes. Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before crossing. Another train may be coming on a different track.

questions.question: What should you do if you see a road covered with water?

options.text: Drive through until the water seems too deep.
Drive through, the water is probably not too deep.
Turn around and find a different route.
Walk into the water to check how deep it is.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn around and find a different route.
questions.explanation: Do not drive through flooded roads. You cannot tell how deep the water is or how fast it is moving. Your vehicle could become submerged or swept away.

questions.question: What factors affect how alcohol influences your body?

options.text: How much food is in your stomach.
How much time passes between drinks.

questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Eating can slow alcohol absorption but cannot prevent impairment from drinking too much.

questions.question: What is the maximum safe speed for driving?

options.text: A speed that is reasonable and safe for conditions.
A speed appropriate for road and weather conditions.

questions.explanation: Drive at a speed that is reasonable and safe. Consider the area, traffic, pedestrians, weather, road condition, and light. Always stay within legal speed limits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
The safe speed limit for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to avoid accidents.
Passing slow drivers by speeding ahead of them.
Following the car ahead of you very closely.
Quickly changing lanes to move through traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to avoid accidents.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means you see dangerous situations and act before an accident happens. It helps you avoid bad drivers, careless drivers, drunk drivers, and unsafe pedestrians.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on an interstate?

options.text: Pull over on the shoulder if you feel tired.
Signal, check mirrors, and check your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, check mirrors, and check your blind spot before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Always signal, check your mirrors, and check your blind spot before changing lanes or passing. Only pull over on the shoulder in an emergency. Do not use cruise control in heavy traffic or bad weather. Change lanes as little as possible.

questions.question: Which offense will automatically suspend your license?

options.text: Failing to stop and help after an accident.

questions.explanation: These offenses cause automatic license suspension: driving while intoxicated, failing to stop and help after an accident, and driving with an invalid license.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: When passing a large truck, what should a driver of a small car be ready for?

options.text: Strong wind gusts from the large truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Strong wind gusts from the large truck.
questions.explanation: Large trucks create strong wind gusts that can push smaller vehicles. Be ready to steer properly when passing or driving near large trucks, especially at high speeds.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line mean?

options.text: You may pass if it is safe.
Both lanes go in the same direction.
You may pass even if it is dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A single dashed yellow line means you can pass if it is safe. Only pass if you will not interfere with oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What is distracted driving?

options.text: Just as safe as any other driving.

questions.explanation: Distracted driving is very dangerous. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers at risk. Pay full attention to driving to prevent crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What do downward-facing triangular signs tell you?

options.text: You are in a school zone.
You are in a construction zone.

questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs tell you to yield. Once the road is clear and it is safe, you may go.
